mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect overcast skies and temperatures around 61 degrees near Fireman's Park under a third quarter moon. The space station passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is welcoming Deputy Chief Liz Gay to Fitch-Rona EMS, where she will oversee administration and employee development. Residents are also reminded to place refuse and recycling carts out before 7 AM on collection days.

If you are looking for local entertainment today, trivia nights are taking place at Hop Haus Brewing Company, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, Paddy Mac's will host live music while Insight Wellness offers yoga classes.
In police news, on Tuesday officers assisted emergency personnel with a witnessed cardiac arrest on Basswood Avenue, deploying an A E D before the patient was transported to a local hospital.
Today's Culver's flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently closed for the morning and will open today at 10:00 AM.
